stories.title: Trillium College students disappointed at selective return to classes
stories.summary: Students at one career college are decrying its approach to the OSAP pause, with the school allowing only those who can pay without the financial aid to continue learning.

stories.title: Ford holds off on new cash for Stellantis plant, contradicting minister
stories.summary: Doug Ford's minister responsible for the tariffs response said the province is willing to offer Stellantis additional financial support to stay in Brampton.

stories.title: Ontario tables law to more quickly deal with intimate image abuse
stories.summary: The proposed new statutory tort giving those victims access to civil remedies is contained in an omnibus bill introduced on Monday.

stories.title: Raptors emphasize accountability after Knicks loss
stories.summary: RJ Barrett understands why Toronto Raptors fans are frustrated, but he hopes they can be more patient.

stories.title: Former Leafs executive Bill Watters dies at 83
stories.summary: Bill Watters, the former Toronto Maple Leafs executive, player agent and broadcaster whose career spanned decades in Canadian hockey, has died at 83.

stories.title: Leafs GM John Chayka backs head coach Jim Hiller
stories.summary: John Chayka isn't looking to assign blame.

stories.title: Ontario Catholic teachers vote strongly in favour of strike mandate
stories.summary: The union representing Catholic teachers says educators are dealing with chronic classroom underfunding by the Ford government.

stories.title: Infant among 3 dead in Burlington house fire
stories.summary: Officials confirmed Monday that an adult male, a 12-year-old child and a one-year-old baby have died. An adult female and one other child remain in critical condition.

stories.title: Canada’s Alert Ready emergency system will test notifications on Wednesday
stories.summary: The emergency alerts are used by governments to inform the public of emergencies including tornadoes, floods, wildfires and Amber Alerts

stories.title: Mississauga’s data centre moratorium facing challenge from American company
stories.summary: An American-based logistics company is looking to overturn the municipality's one-year moratorium on artificial intelligence data centres.
